name: bubble
title: Bubble
description: A speech, thought or shout bubble around the page's own paragraph. Quiet is a hairline callout with a small tail in plain CSS text. Warm draws a hand-inked bubble and lays the words into its real shape, line by line, through the type tier; playful adds a bolder pen, a shadow, a tilt, a torn edge on a shout and a pop out of the tail. The words stay real text (one span per line inside the paragraph, or CSS shape-outside for the still), the speaker is named for screen readers, and a bubble that cannot hold the words at a legible size grows, then falls back to plain flow, and never clips.

budget.reason: A component (decisions 0005 and 0010 say 36 KB with the pieces counted); raised to 40 KB, then to 52 KB for the distance-field zone kernel (bubble.zones.core.js), which the owner's ruling that budgets stay flexible while the foundations go in allows. The kernel adds a pure signed-distance core with a documented ellipse error and a proof-by-test clearance. Today 50208 raw JS bytes of 11 files with comments: element 2860, pure core 16490, the zone kernel 11938, the drawn-bubble skin body.js 15628 (three layouts, text-spacing meter, arrival), the live surface bubble.live.js 700, three one-line skins 899. The type tier and Pretext are counted apart and are requested only at warm or playful with motion on.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure. The comic speech balloon is a worldwide convention, and the demo's made-up speakers (a crow, a bread man, a fish seller, a cat) are everyday Goan life, not a tradition drawn from.
